THE PROBLEM                                                                                                                                                                                                        lyzr.ai




Supply chains are losing billions
to manual planning and siloed systems.
Planners spend most of the week firefighting exceptions. Dashboards show what broke — rarely what to
do. Legacy planning engines deploy in years, not weeks. The outcome: millions in lost revenue and eroded
margins every quarter.

From dashboards to autonomous execution.
Enterprises move through five autonomy tiers. Most are stuck at tiers 1–2. Agentic AI is what makes tiers
3–5 economically viable for the first time.

How to read every number in this deck.
Three independent layers back every KPI, ROI, and outcome band on the slides. Any one answers 80% of
the objections on its own; together they remove the ambiguity.



    Layer 01                                                                                  Layer 02                                                             Layer 03

A P P E N D I X · B A N D S LO G I C                                                                                                                                                                                                      lyzr.ai




Why ranges — and how they are constructed.
We avoid single-point claims because supply chains differ. The band captures the distribution of
observed outcomes across operating models, data maturity, and scope — exactly what a responsible
buyer should expect to see.



    Rule A                                                               Rule B                                                               Rule C                                             Rule D
    Union range                                                          Single source                                                        No double-counting                                 Position within band
    Where 2+ studies cover the same KPI, we                              Where only one credible source exists, we cite                       Portfolio-level numbers (e.g., 8–12% EBITDA        Baseline, data maturity, process readiness and
    report the union — lowest low to highest high.
    Narrower sub-bands cited on the slide for                    →       it by name on the slide. No interpolation; the
                                                                         provenance is visible.                                       →       uplift) are drawn from studies that measured
                                                                                                                                              portfolio outcomes directly — never summed     →   scope determine where you land. Narrow-
                                                                                                                                                                                                 scope pilots land near the low end; cross-
    clarity.                                                                                                                                  from per-agent figures.                            module at maturity reaches the high end.

APPENDIX · COMMITMENTS                                                                                                                                                                                                                   lyzr.ai




What Lyzr commits to — and what it does not.
Honest framing up-front removes the biggest stall in procurement. Platform commitments sit in the MSA;
outcome commitments sit in the pilot SOW; research bands stay informational.


       LY Z R C O M M I T S T O · C O N T R A C T U A L                                                                                                LY Z R D O E S N O T · I N F O R M AT I O N A L



       In writing                                                                                                                                      Not contractual
       · Platform uptime, response-time SLA, integration milestones — in the MSA.                                                                      · Platform-level %-improvement guarantees — outcomes depend on your data and
       · Pilot success gate with financial consequences if missed — in the SOW.                                                                        scope. No industry vendor SLAs these.
       · SOC 2 Type II, RBAC, audit ledger, BYOK, private cloud — standard.                                                                            · Research-band figures as guarantees — bands are industry-observed, not Lyzr-
       · Customer owns integration IP and pilot baseline data — default.                                                                               promised.
       · Rollback-safe architecture — every agent write is reversible.                                                                                 · Year-1 ROI on a fixed timeline beyond pilot scope — depends on agents rolled out.




Standard in enterprise AI procurement — no platform vendor SLAs business outcomes at the platform level; outcome commitments live in services / SOW.
